cancellationPolicies.label: Deposit Only rates
cancellationPolicies.description: This property has a 2 day cancellation policy. Failure to cancel within this time will result in a cancellation charge equal to the first night of your stay, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information).

cancellationPolicies.description: Your booking is non-refundable. If you choose to cancel your booking, or in the case of a no-show, you will still be charged the full cost of your booking.

specialEventConditions.title: New Years 2025-26
specialEventConditions.description: Hello traveler!  Please note that between December 20th, 2025 and January 5th 2026, all bookings are non refundable and non transferable.  These bookings are to be paid in full 30 days prior to arrival.  Thanks for your attention, and we hope you enjoy your stay!

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 29th Dec 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 29th Dec 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
